name: SoundsOfJPGAlbum #3
description:
SOUNDSOFJPG ALBUM is not any ordinary NFT-Music. It's a historical artistic experimentation. 

It's the first ever album that were made from images (JPG Files), a continuation from Cryptophobia (CP) sound-collectible project: SoundsOfJPG, where he generated sound from RGB Histogram data of JPG files. SoundsOfJPG collection have gained a big recognition among the Crypto-Art scene, It's been collected by some names like XCOPY,Trevor Jones, Misan Harriman and Claire Silver among others. 

Now, in this Album, CP expand his experimentation by featuring art from artists: DORKHOLM, CRASHBLOSSOM, ROBNESS, and TUUKZS , generated their JPG files into sound, and combining it with his drum-machine.
